Only witch–sorcerer pairs shook hands, so the total is 6 × 10 = 60.

Solution A counts this correctly, from both the witches' side and the sorcerers' side, and gets 60 each time.

Solution B is wrong. It counts the witch–sorcerer handshakes once as 60, then counts them again as the sorcerers' handshakes. It also subtracts handshakes between sorcerers, which never happened. That gives 111.

WINNER: A
